title: Unit 1: Amazing People: Present Tenses & Personality
objective: Mampu menggunakan present perfect dengan just, already, dan yet untuk membicarakan hal yang sudah dan belum dilakukan, serta membandingkannya dengan past simple. Siswa juga dapat mendeskripsikan kepribadian seseorang menggunakan kata sifat yang tepat dan memberikan dukungan dalam percakapan.

theory.summary: Unit ini mengajarkan perbedaan antara present perfect dan past simple. Present perfect digunakan untuk tindakan yang relevan dengan sekarang atau tanpa waktu spesifik. Past simple digunakan untuk tindakan di waktu tertentu di masa lalu. Kata just, already, dan yet sering dipakai dengan present perfect untuk menunjukkan waktu tindakan.
rules: Present Perfect + just: I have just finished my homework. (Baru saja selesai, relevan dengan sekarang)
Present Perfect + already: She has already come back from Papua New Guinea. (Sudah selesai lebih cepat dari yang diharapkan)
Present Perfect + yet: They haven't made any recordings yet. (Belum terjadi, tapi kita harapkan akan segera terjadi)
Past Simple untuk waktu spesifik: She wrote her first book when she was just five. (Waktu jelas: when she was five)
Present Perfect tanpa waktu spesifik: He has visited Greece more than 20 times. (Tidak ada waktu spesifik disebutkan)

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Mencampur Present Perfect dengan Waktu Spesifik
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula menggunakan present perfect bersama keterangan waktu spesifik seperti 'yesterday' atau 'in 1998'. Ini salah karena present perfect tidak menyebutkan waktu spesifik, hanya past simple yang boleh.
commonTrap.correct: I visited Greece in 1998. (atau) I have visited Greece before.

vocab.collocation: She is extremely brave. She travels to some of the most dangerous places on Earth.
She's really charming and all of Bia's friends think she's fab.
He's so creative and finds different ways to get us interested in his lessons.
He's seriously talented. He's in a band.
He's really laid-back but we all respect him.
She's such a positive person, always seeing the good in other people.
She's one of the most active people I know. She spends a lot of her time doing things for charity.
He's always so cheerful with a huge smile on his face.

dialogue.context: Sekelompok teman sedang membahas siapa yang harus membuka kafe baru di taman. Mereka mendiskusikan berbagai pilihan dan memberikan pendapat tentang siapa yang paling cocok.

lines.speaker: Luke
lines.text: Have you read this? They're opening a new café in the park. Saturday afternoon.
lines.translation: Kamu sudah baca ini? Mereka membuka kafe baru di taman. Sabtu sore.

lines.speaker: Olivia
lines.text: That's fantastic. Who's going to do the big opening ceremony?
lines.translation: Itu fantastis. Siapa yang akan melakukan upacara pembukaan besar?

lines.speaker: Ryan
lines.text: The mayor probably. She always does shop openings and conferences, that sort of thing.
lines.translation: Walikota mungkin. Dia selalu melakukan pembukaan toko dan konferensi, hal semacam itu.

lines.speaker: Luke
lines.text: Hey, I know. They should get Paul Norris. Yeah! He's a great footballer! He plays for United now, but he grew up round here.
lines.translation: Hei, aku tahu. Mereka harus mengundang Paul Norris. Ya! Dia pemain sepak bola hebat! Dia bermain untuk United sekarang, tapi dia tumbuh di sekitar sini.

lines.speaker: Olivia
lines.text: But he doesn't live round here any more. He's a star now. Let's face it, he won't want to open a little park café.
lines.translation: Tapi dia tidak tinggal di sekitar sini lagi. Dia bintang sekarang. Hadapi kenyataan, dia tidak akan mau membuka kafe taman kecil.

lines.speaker: Megan
lines.text: Know what, guys? I've just thought of someone very special, and he's just the person for the job.
lines.translation: Tahu tidak? Aku baru saja memikirkan seseorang yang sangat spesial, dan dia adalah orang yang tepat untuk pekerjaan ini.

speakingLab.context: Kamu sedang berbincang dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang orang yang kamu kagumi. Dia ingin tahu lebih banyak tentang kepribadian orang tersebut dan apa yang membuatnya istimewa bagimu.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today I'd like to hear about someone you really admire. Can you tell me who that person is and why you chose them?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I admire my grandmother. She's 78 and very active.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's wonderful! What makes your grandmother so special to you? What kind of personality does she have?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: She's very positive and cheerful. She always sees the good in people and helps others.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: She sounds like an amazing person! Has she done anything recently that impressed you?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, she's just raised money for a children's charity. She did a parachute jump!

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: A parachute jump at 78? That's incredibly brave! You must be very proud of her. What have you learned from her?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: She's taught me that life is for living and to always help other people.

quiz.question: She ___ just ___ back from Papua New Guinea.
quiz.explanation: Present perfect menggunakan 'has/have + past participle'. 'Just' menunjukkan baru saja terjadi, jadi gunakan present perfect: has come.

quiz.question: They haven't made any recordings ___, but they've already attracted lots of interest.
quiz.explanation: 'Yet' digunakan dalam kalimat negatif dan pertanyaan present perfect untuk menunjukkan sesuatu belum terjadi tapi diharapkan akan terjadi.

quiz.question: When did Daniel write his first book? (Choose the correct answer)
options: He has written it when he was five.
He wrote it when he was five.
He writes it when he was five.
quiz.answer: He wrote it when he was five.
quiz.explanation: Karena ada waktu spesifik 'when he was five', kita harus menggunakan past simple, bukan present perfect.

quiz.question: Which sentence uses present perfect correctly?
options: I have visited Greece more than 20 times.
quiz.answer: I have visited Greece more than 20 times.
quiz.explanation: Present perfect tidak menyebutkan waktu spesifik. 'More than 20 times' tidak menyebutkan kapan tepatnya, jadi ini benar.

quiz.question: Which adjective best describes someone who travels to dangerous places? She is extremely ___.
quiz.explanation: 'Brave' berarti berani. Seseorang yang pergi ke tempat berbahaya memerlukan keberanian.

quiz.question: He's really ___ but we all respect him. (Choose the personality adjective that means relaxed)
quiz.explanation: 'Laid-back' berarti santai dan tenang. Ini menggambarkan seseorang yang tidak tegang atau stres.
